content: Kakaɨyari Rawiri kemɨtiutahɨawixɨ
Hikɨ ti'aitame Rawiri kepauka yuparatsiyuta 'ayekaitɨ matɨa, Yawé 'uxipiya kanipitɨani yunaitɨ memeye'unie memɨka'i'uximatɨakakɨ.

Hikɨ Rawiri Natani Kakaɨyari niukameya mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Neɨxei, 'aixɨa pɨka'ane ne paratsiyuta nemayeka kariuxa kɨyeyari kiiyarita, Kakaɨyari tɨratuya kakuniyari, 'ixuriki kiiyarita 'ayekaikaku.
Natani mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —'Aixɨa kani'aneni. 'Ekɨ ti'aitame yaketineuyuri kepemɨti'akuhɨawe, Yawé matsi 'ahamatɨa kaniuyeikani.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ tɨkariyaritsie Yawé niukieya Natani hetsɨa kaninuani mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe:
«Kenemie mɨpaɨ ketinetahɨawi Rawiri neti'uximayatsiriwame Yawé mɨpaɨ kanaineni: “'Ekɨ pepɨkahɨkɨ kii pemɨnetsitawewirieni muwa nemayekanikɨ.
Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi 'Ekipitu nemɨwarayewitɨtsie paitɨtɨ hatsuaku kiita nepɨka'ayeyerɨwe, matsi xeikɨa nepukuyeika, 'ixuriki tukiyarita ne'ayekaitɨ.

Kepaɨmexɨa tukari 'ixaheritsixi wahamatɨa nemuyeikakai, kepauka 'itsɨkate nemɨwarutanɨ'a neteɨterima 'ixaheritsixi memɨwata'ɨwiyakɨ, hatsuaku mɨkɨ xeime nepɨka'utati mɨkanetsi'utawewirikɨ kariuxa kiiyari”.

»Kamɨtsɨ, Rawiri neti'uximayatsiriwame mɨpaɨ ketineutahɨawi, mɨpaɨ kanaineni Yawé Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye: “Ne muxatsi pewahɨnekaku nekamananayexeiya, matsi pɨta neteɨterima 'ixaheritsixi pemɨtiwata'aitɨanikɨ.
Ne 'ahamatɨa nepuyeikakai tsepa kepemɨtikuyeikakai, 'ahetsiemieme memɨmatsi'aye'unie yunaime nekaniwarakuxɨtɨani. Hikɨ waɨkawa pemariweme nekamanayeitɨamɨkɨ 'ena kwiepa memɨmamariwawe wahepaɨ.
Meta neteɨterima 'ixaheritsixi nekaniwayetuiriemɨkɨ kwie, mana yuheyemekɨ memɨtitenikɨ 'aixɨa 'iyari mekamariutsietɨ. Mana memɨwaraye'unie mepɨkawa'uximatɨakari meripaitɨ kememɨwayuriekai,

kepauka 'itsɨkate nemɨwaranuka'uitɨwakaitsie neteɨterima 'ixaheritsixi wahetsie. Meta 'ekɨ nekamanipitɨamɨkɨ kayuwatɨ pemuyeikanikɨ yunaime memɨmatsi'aye'unie watsata. »”Peru hikɨ Yawé mɨpaɨ kamatinahɨaweni yapemɨtimaikakɨ mɨkɨ kamanipitɨamɨkɨ 'anuiwari kii manukuketɨanikɨ.
Kepaukari pemɨmɨni meta kepauka 'apaapama wahamatɨa pemɨkateukieni, 'anuiwaritsie xeime nepanayexeiya mɨtita'aitakɨ, meta yamɨtiyurienikɨ.
Mɨkɨ pɨhɨkɨtɨni kii nehetsiemieme mɨtawewieni muwa 'aixɨa nemɨtimariwanikɨ meta heitserie nepipitɨani yuheyemekɨ mɨti'aitanikɨ.
Ne paapaya nepɨhɨkɨtɨni, mɨkɨta neniwe pɨhɨkɨtɨni. 'Ayumieme kepauka 'axamɨtiyurieni, nekaneyemari'itɨamɨkɨ ne'iwaɨyɨkɨ, rapaapa mɨtiuka'iyari hepaɨ.
Peru ne'inaki'erietɨ nepɨka'ihayewa, Tsahuri kenemɨtiuhayewaxɨ hepaɨ, 'ekɨ pɨta hetsiena mieme heitserie nemɨmatsipitɨanikɨ.
'Anuiwarima yuheyemekɨ 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ mepu'uwani nehɨxie, 'a'uweni yuheyemekɨ 'apuweni”».
Hikɨ Natani Kakaɨyari niukameya Rawiri 'ikɨ naime katiniutaxatɨani, kemɨtiutahekɨatɨarie heinɨtsi hepaɨ 'anemekɨ.
Rawiri nenewierieya
Hikɨ Rawiri ti'aitame kaneyani Yawé tɨratuya kakuniyari hɨxie 'utayerɨka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Yawé meta Kakaɨyari, ¿kepaikɨ ne nepɨhɨkɨ meta netɨɨriyama, titayari mariweme penerayeitɨwani?

Yawé Kakaɨyari, waɨkawari pepɨnetiupitɨa, kamɨtsɨ hikɨ mɨkɨ 'etsiwa xeikɨa tihɨkɨ 'ahepaɨtsita. Ne mati'uximayatsiriwame nekanihɨkɨtɨni, waɨkawa pepɨnetiutaxatɨa ke'aixɨa pemɨtiyurieni 'arike nenuiwari wahetsiemieme. Yawé Kakaɨyari teɨteri wahetsiemieme mariweme pepɨtiyuriene.
»¿Kehepaɨ tawarita mati'uximayatsiriwame Rawiri matitahɨawe yapekatinimaikari, 'ekɨ Yawé nekakaɨyari?
Mariwemekɨ 'ikɨ pekatiniuyurieni 'aniuki pehaye'atɨatɨ, kemɨmatinake hikɨ ne mati'uximayatsiriwame pemɨnetiutahekɨatɨa.
»Pepɨmariwe 'ekɨ, Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe. Tame mɨpaɨ tekatenetimani xewitɨ kaniumaweni 'ahepaɨ tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ meta tawarita yuri kakaɨyari pumawe.

Hakewatsɨ nuiwari 'ateɨterima 'ixaheritsixi wahepaɨ me'anetɨ mepe'uwa. 'Ikɨ nuiwari xeikɨa pekaniuxɨna 'ena kwiepa, 'ateɨterima pewarayeitɨanike meta wahetsie pemetimatiwakɨ kepemɨtimariwe. Mariwemekɨ pekatiniuyurieni kepauka 'ateɨterima wahɨxie, 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie kepemɨtatiutawikweitsitɨa, nuiwarite kananitari kepemɨtiwarayeweiyaxɨa meta wakakaɨyarixi.
'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie pekatiniuwiya 'ateɨterima yuheyemekɨ memɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ meta 'ekɨ Yawé wakakaɨyari pemɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ.
»Hikɨ Yawé meta Kakaɨyari heitseriemekɨ yaketineuyuri ne mati'uximayatsiriwame kepemɨnetiutahɨawixɨ meta nenuiwarima wahetsiemieme. 'Aniuki kenaye'atɨa

teɨteri memɨmatsimaikakɨ yuheyemekɨ kemɨ'ane pemɨhɨkɨ, meta yunaitɨ 'aixɨa memutiyuanenikɨ 'ahepaɨtsita mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: “Yawé Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye 'ixaheritsixi kaniwakakaɨyaritɨni”. Hikɨ ne Rawiri mati'uximayatsiriwame nehɨkɨtɨtɨ nenuiwari yuheyemekɨ 'ahɨxie kaniyuhayewakamɨkɨ.
»Yawé Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye 'ixaheritsixi wakakaɨyari, 'ekɨ mati'uximayatsiriwame meripaitɨ pepɨnetiutahekɨatɨa nenuiwaritsie kepemɨtiyurieni, 'ayumieme ne mati'uximayatsiriwame mɨyanematinikɨhɨaweni.
Yawé nekakaɨyari, ne mati'uximayatsiriwame waɨkawamekɨ kepemɨnetiutaxatɨa 'aixɨa mɨti'anekɨ, 'ekɨ pekanikakaɨyaritɨni meta kepemutayɨ kaniyuritɨni.

Neuxeitsɨ ne mati'uximayatsiriwame neniwema 'aixɨa keniwaruyuri, mɨpaɨ 'ekɨ pewa'ɨwiyakaku yuheyemekɨ mekaniu'uwakakuni nenuiwarima, 'ekɨtsɨ Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe yapekaniutayɨni. Xɨka nenuiwari 'aixɨa pewaruyurieni yuheyemekɨ 'aixɨa me'itɨarietɨ mepuyuhayewani».
